summary.en: Wheelchair entrance gag, festival mud, then a set that locks grunge into UK festival memory.
summary.zh: 轮椅入场梗、音乐节的泥，然后一场演出把 grunge 焊进英国音乐节记忆。

whyEpic.en: Reading '92 is where underground refusal meets festival headliner scale. Teen Spirit is no longer only a radio hit; it is shared across a field. The set becomes a standard reference for early-90s alternative live.
whyEpic.zh: 1992 雷丁是地下拒绝姿态遇见音乐节主打规模的节点。Teen Spirit 不再只是电台热歌；整片草地共享它。这场成为 90 年代初 alternative 现场的标准参照。

rightsNote.en: Official releases exist. We don't embed full sets.
rightsNote.zh: 有官方发行。我们不嵌整场。
